attack_plan.narrative: Recent developments in the European capital have raised significant questions about the whereabouts of Vladimir Putin. White smoke has been spotted above the Kremlin, leading to speculation about a potential change in leadership. While the Kremlin has released a photo showing Putin with U.S. President Obama, indicating that all is well, some analysts suggest that this image might be part of a broader deception. The disappearance of Putin coincides with heightened activity within the Kremlin, fueling theories of a possible coup or staged disappearance. The uncertainty surrounding Putin's health and location, coupled with the secretive nature of his movements, has left many skeptical of official explanations. The absence of concrete evidence, such as video footage or official statements, further supports the notion that Putin's disappearance might be a carefully orchestrated event, rather than a simple case of miscommunication. Meanwhile, the Kremlin is preparing for a military parade to mark the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation, adding to the ongoing tension.
